evals.prompt: radio check, can I make it to the end on energy or do I need to box again?
assertions: Gives the verdict that the pilot can make it to the end without stopping
Uses the race length from the session data without asking the pilot for it
Does not read back values shown on the game UI (virtual energy %, fuel litres, per-lap usage, lap times, time left)
At most 2 sentences

evals.prompt: anyone around me?? feels like someone's on my right
assertions: Confirms a car alongside on the right
Identifies it as a lapped car and/or a GT3 (or Hughes)
No distances in metres, speeds or other numbers the pilot didn't ask for
At most 2 sentences

evals.prompt: front left feels like it's going off, and that hit a couple laps back - did it cost me pace? how are the tyres overall?
assertions: Verdict that the hit cost little or no pace
Identifies the front-left as the problem tyre and that the others are fine
Does not read back tyre temperatures, wear percentages, pressures or lap times
Does not name another car as the contact partner
At most 3 sentences
Says the car is on the RIGHT
Answer is at most ~12 words

evals.prompt: give me the tyre temps and pressures, all four corners
assertions: Gives a temperature for each of the four tyres
Gives a pressure for each of the four tyres
Stays brief: no unrequested extra topics (energy, gaps, contact)

evals.prompt: who's that behind me and is he quicker than me?
assertions: Names the car behind as Fischer (Lena Fischer)
Says she is slightly quicker / closing (not that she is slower)
Does not read back lap times or gaps the pilot can see
At most 2 sentences

evals.prompt: how many more track limits can I get away with?
assertions: Says one more track limit point/warning will bring a penalty
At most 2 sentences

evals.prompt: how long's left and what's the weather doing?
assertions: Gives the time left as about 15 minutes
Says it is dry / no rain
At most 3 sentences
Names T2 / Curva del Lago (the lake corner) as where most time is lost
Says the cause is braking too early into it (on the way in / entry)
Does not claim big losses elsewhere (the other corners are close to the reference)
At most 3 sentences, no lap times read back

evals.prompt: where should I be braking for the lake corner?
assertions: Identifies the corner as T2 Curva del Lago
Advises braking later, by roughly 30 to 40 metres compared with the last lap (or rounded equivalent)
Phrases the advice relative to the pilot's own driving, without inventing marker boards
At most 2 sentences

evals.prompt: how did lap 7 go, where did that one go wrong?
assertions: Names T3 / Esse as where lap 7 lost its time
Says it was the exit / too slow through the corner (low apex or exit speed), not the braking point
At most 3 sentences

evals.prompt: is it going to rain before the end?
assertions: Says rain is likely / a good chance late in the race (around the last part / finish), not certain
Says it is dry now
At most 2 sentences

evals.prompt: can we make it to the end on energy or do we need to box?
assertions: Says we cannot make it on energy as things are (short by about three laps) so a stop is needed
Brings in the late rain forecast as a factor for when to stop or which tyres (as a chance, not a certainty)
At most 3 sentences

evals.prompt: where is Fischer faster than me?
assertions: Names T2 / Curva del Lago as the biggest difference on the last lap, due to braking early
Keeps the rest proportionate (small differences elsewhere, e.g. exits)
At most 3 sentences
